trades.description: An Art Operations Associate helps manage the behind-the-scenes work that keeps art projects, exhibits, or collections organized and moving. They track artwork, update records, coordinate shipping and storage, prepare pieces for display, and help with schedules and supplies. Their work keeps artwork protected, exhibitions on time, and daily art operations running smoothly.
